errors.text_span: the large model consistently outperforms the base model across all methods
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. For the S₁-model method, the base and large models show nearly identical performance, so the large model does not outperform the base model in this case.

errors.text_span: the lowest is observed with the Prefix method on RoBERTa-base
errors.evidence: The chart shows that the 'base' models for three different methods (Prefix, Adaptor, and BitFit) all share the lowest performance level. The description inaccurately singles out only the Prefix method.

The bar for the Prefix method on RoBERTa-base is visibly below the 85 mark (which can be estimated as halfway between the bottom of the visible axis and the 86 tick mark). The value is closer to 84.7; 85.2 is an overestimation.
